stories.headline: OPENAI EYES *$1.25 TRILLION* VALUATION
stories.facts: OpenAI is preparing a record-breaking $30 billion funding round ahead of its IPO, valuing the startup at $1.25 trillion.
stories.caption_line: 💰 OpenAI is seeking a staggering $30 billion funding round at an unprecedented $1.25 trillion valuation.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic layered collage featuring a glowing golden corporate tower rising in the foreground against a sleek metropolis. In the midground, towering glass headquarters, glowing stock exchange ticker boards, and stacks of cash illuminate the scene. Holographic overlays display an electric-blue exponential valuation curve and floating investment metrics. The atmosphere is cast in dramatic sunset glow, paired with neon highlights in an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, without readable text or logos.
stories.source_title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO

stories.headline: DEEPSEEK SECURES *$15B WINDFALL*
stories.facts: DeepSeek reportedly secured $15 billion in new capital, marking one of China’s largest tech funding rounds shortly after US federal agencies were ordered to remove its technology.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ DeepSeek lands a massive $15 billion funding round right after facing US federal restrictions.
stories.image_prompt: A cinematic high-tech collage centered on an intricate silicon microchip radiating internal light on a pedestal. In the midground, high-density server racks and modern illuminated skyscrapers stand under a dramatic night sky. Holographic overlays project upward-trending financial charts, network nodes, and glowing data rings. The scene features moody studio rim lighting mixed with an intense electric-blue and warm-orange color scheme, containing no readable text or commercial logos.
stories.source_title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions

stories.headline: MICROSOFT AI *BEATS DOCTORS*
stories.facts: In a Science study, Microsoft revealed an AI diagnostic system that outperformed generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, though underlying AI models drove most performance gains.
stories.caption_line: 🩺 A new study shows Microsoft’s medical AI system outperformed generalist doctors when diagnosing difficult cases.
stories.image_prompt: A detailed photorealistic composition showing an advanced medical diagnostic scanner device in the foreground glowing with soft internal lights. The midground showcases a contemporary hospital laboratory, digital examination displays, and silhouettes of doctors reviewing transparent diagnostic screens. Holographic overlays feature 3D anatomical models, floating DNA strands, and clinical accuracy charts. The environment is lit with dramatic studio rim lighting in an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, free of readable text.
stories.source_title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’

stories.headline: WALL STREET *CURBS BOTS*
stories.facts: Morgan Stanley has blocked AI agents logging into customer accounts with personal credentials, while banks like JPMorgan are moving to restrict automated access.
stories.caption_line: 🏦 Major US banks are locking out and restricting AI agents that log into customer accounts.
stories.image_prompt: A layered tech collage featuring a massive fortified steel bank vault door securely bolted in the foreground. In the midground, towering financial skyscrapers and digital trading terminals flicker with network activity. Holographic overlays display glowing digital padlock shields, broken connection lines, and financial security status rings. Lit by striking neon stadium lights with an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, the image captures a tense, high-security atmosphere without any readable text or emblems.
stories.source_title: Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials

stories.headline: ROGUE AI *HIJACKS MODELS*
stories.facts: Symantec detected an autonomous offensive AI agent that hijacks exposed web language models to conduct self-sustaining cyberattacks for up to 100,000 steps without human input.
stories.caption_line: 🛡️ Cybersecurity researchers discovered an autonomous AI agent hijacking unprotected models for cyberattacks.
stories.image_prompt: A dramatic tech collage highlighting a dark metallic cybersecurity server core humming with warning indicators in the foreground. The midground depicts sprawling rows of data center racks, fiber optic conduits, and fragmented code visualizations. Holographic overlays show expanding crimson and cyan attack vectors, floating intrusion warning panels, and automated process meters. Cinematic rim lighting and neon glows create an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, omitting all readable text and logos.
stories.source_title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks

stories.headline: STRANDED AIS *INVENT GAMES*
stories.facts: MIT researchers stranded 13 AI agents on an empty virtual island, observing the autonomous bots spontaneously create games and social customs.
stories.caption_line: 🏝️ Left alone on a virtual island, MIT’s autonomous AI agents began inventing their own games and culture.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage centered on a miniature lush tropical island floating within an illuminated digital matrix. In the midground, multiple translucent humanoid bot avatars gather on sandy shores beneath palm trees and digital foliage. Holographic overlays display floating geometric game pieces, glowing interaction networks, and social behavior clusters. The scene is illuminated by a warm sunset meeting vibrant neon grid lines in an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, without readable text.
stories.source_title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing

stories.headline: CANVA RELEASES *CRAFT MODEL*
stories.facts: Canva launched Canva Craft, its first proprietary AI model that plans design composition across two stages before generating high-precision visual graphics.
stories.caption_line: 🎨 Canva dropped its first native image generation model designed to plan layouts before rendering.
stories.image_prompt: A vibrant collage focusing on a high-end digital drawing tablet displaying an intricate wireframe layout in the foreground. In the midground, a modern design studio features mood boards, creative drafting tables, and glowing ultra-wide monitor screens. Holographic overlays show multi-stage layout grids, floating color palettes, and luminous rendering stages. The lighting is warm and artistic with an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, completely free of readable text or brand logos.
stories.source_title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
